title: First time in mallworld
content: I had my first mall world dream last night. I remember being in a place that was essentially a cross between hot topic and spirit Halloween. I went to the mall and started out at the entrance and basically bee lined for the store like I had been there before. But then I left for a while and was wondering around the busy mall. But then I remember getting in an area that was dark and abandoned but I could see shadows moving out of the corners of my eyes and felt like if I didn’t leave I’d be killed. Then I eventually got back to the shop and people were around. It was really weird.
